ruleset.name: it-conventions
ruleset.description: Stricter companion to test-conventions.xml for the backend service modules: besides control statements, tests must not hide branching or looping in boolean operators, comparisons or callbacks. One scenario per test; cases that differ only in data are @ParameterizedTest rows. Plumbing that needs logic lives in a test harness/ package (excluded, like in test-conventions).

rule.name: NoLogicOperatorsInTests
rule.message: Tests must be linear: no &&, ||, !, == or != (assert the values instead)
rule.description: Boolean and comparison operators are conditional logic; assert with AssertJ instead.

rule.name: NoCallbackBranchingInTests
rule.message: Tests must be linear: no forEach/filter/ifPresent/orElseGet callbacks (move plumbing to harness/)
rule.description: Callback-style loops and branches are control flow in disguise.
